Her element — krypton: a colourless, odourless noble gas, about one part in a million of the air we breathe, found in 1898 in the last residue of evaporating liquid air and named from Greek kryptos, the hidden one; in a discharge tube it glows a smoky white-violet, and from 1960 to 1983 a single orange-red line of its light defined the length of the metre; it flares in photographic flash lamps and rests sealed between the panes of triple-glazed windows — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.
